player_prompt.intro:
Jani wakichi {player_id} khuskatäwi. Guess The Number sartäwi.
Jan walja chhuxchix mä aru {min_number} ch'iyar uñt'ataru {max_number} p'unchaypachar uka turnirinakax {max_turns}.
Jani ukhamaraki, jach'a khaya, 'jani wali' sasaw 'jani p'isi' sasin irpaya.
Jan ukhamaraki, maynix mä q'ala, ukar uñt'at q'awirinakax q'awiri. Wakicht'awi, example, [5].
Jani jach'a khaya, ukhamaraki, wakichirinakax q'awirinakax uka p'unchaypachar juk'ampi. Ukatpacha, jani wakichirinakax jach'a khayapataki.
Ukhamaraki.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Jach'a khaya aru. Wakichi {player_id} jaqinakax mä aru '[number]' sasaw apna.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Invalid move. Player {player_id} guessed a number outside the range specified.
invalid_move.already_guessed: Invalid move. Player {player_id} has already guessed the number.
